text: dsh-device-info 是面向 DSH 的本机信息工具插件：它注册 12 个工具，读取时间、Windows 系统与硬件信息，并以结构化结果供模型调用。win_time 可跨平台获取本地时间、时区和运行时长；Windows 上还可查询系统身份、CPU、内存、磁盘、显卡、网络与 WiFi、电池、进程、USB、音频和打印机。它通过 Node os 与 PowerShell WMI/CIM 采集数据，支持查询超时和取消，适合需要让 DSH 了解当前电脑状态的场景。Windows 设备查询需 PowerShell；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-device-info adds 12 tools for local time and Windows system, hardware, network, battery, processes and peripherals. It uses Node os and PowerShell WMI/CIM for structured results. Outside Windows only win_time works. Device queries need PowerShell; no API key or external service is needed.
想让 DSH 告诉我这台 Windows 电脑的硬件配置
电脑还剩多少内存，装了哪些内存条？
帮我查看磁盘容量和剩余空间
现在电脑连着什么 WiFi，信号怎么样？
这台机器哪些进程最占 CPU 或内存？
What hardware and system details can DSH read from this Windows PC?
Show me the current battery charge and active power plan.
dsh-device-info 的功能「查询本机时间」：win_time 返回本地时间、时区、UTC 偏移、运行时长和启动时间，不调用 PowerShell。。调用对应的 win_* 工具即可获取结构化结果。
dsh-device-info 的功能「读取 Windows 系统身份」：win_system 查询操作系统版本、主机与用户、厂商型号及 BIOS 信息；可配置是否返回序列号。。调用对应的 win_* 工具即可获取结构化结果。
dsh-device-info 的功能「查看内存与硬件模块」：win_memory 汇总已用、空闲和总内存，并列出物理内存模块的厂商、容量与速度。。调用对应的 win_* 工具即可获取结构化结果。
dsh-device-info 的功能「查看网络与 WiFi」：win_network 返回网络适配器、IP 地址和当前 WiFi 连接的 SSID、信号、频段、信道及速率。。调用对应的 win_* 工具即可获取结构化结果。
dsh-device-info 的功能「查看电池与进程」：win_battery 返回电量、供电状态和电源计划；win_processes 可按内存或累计 CPU 时间列出前 N 个进程。。调用对应的 win_* 工具即可获取结构化结果。
dsh-device-info 的详细设备采集依赖 Windows 和 PowerShell；非 Windows 系统上仅 win_time 可用，其他 Windows 专用工具返回不支持状态。

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · dsh-device-info：**Read-only Windows device info for DeepSeek Harness agents �?12 `win_*` tools, one per Win32 device category.**

`@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info` gives the model structured, **read-only** access to the host machine: time, system, CPU, memory, disk, GPU, network/WiFi, battery, processes, USB, audio, printers. No writes, no installs, no network.

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · Why this plugin：Ad-hoc PowerShell probing costs tokens **every** query �?the model re-generates a command each time (~40�?00+ tokens, more with retries after a typo or a permission prompt). A plugin call is **~6 tokens** against pre-tested, versioned queries. Install once, call any tool; no command-writing, no trial-and-error. (Estimates: `scripts/token-estimate.mjs`; real benchmark planned, see [Roadmap](#roadmap).)

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:lsz-asd/dsh-plugin-device-info   # after publishing
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:C:/path/to/dsh-device-info           # local checkout
```

Restart the profile. `lib/` ships pre-built (no `prepare` script).

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · Tools：| Tool | Reports | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `win_time` | ISO/epoch time, IANA timezone, UTC offset, uptime, boot time | Node `os` �?any platform |
| `win_system` | OS, hostname, user, vendor, model, BIOS, serial (config) | `Win32_ComputerSystem` / `Win32_OperatingSystem` / `Win32_BIOS` |
| `win_cpu` | Model, cores, max clock, load % | `Win32_Processor` |
| `win_memory` | Used/free/total, used %, modules | Node `os` + `Win32_PhysicalMemory` |
| `win_disk` | Drives + volumes (capacity, free) | `Win32_DiskDrive` / `Win32_LogicalDisk` |
| `win_gpu` | Name, VRAM, driver, resolution | `Win32_VideoController` |
| `win_network` | Adapters, IPs, live WiFi (SSID/signal/rates/auth) | `Get-NetAdapter` + `netsh wlan` + Node `os` |
| `win_battery` | Charge %, AC/DC, runtime, power scheme | `Win32_Battery` + `powercfg` |
| `win_processes` | Count + top-N by memory/CPU (`top_n`, `sort_by`) | `Get-Process` |
| `win_usb` | USB devices | `Win32_PnPEntity` |
| `win_audio` | Audio devices | `Win32_SoundDevice` |
| `win_printers` | Printers (driver/port/default/offline) | `Win32_Printer` |

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · Config：| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pwshEnabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` disables all but `win_time`. |
| `pwshTimeoutMs` | `8000` | Per-query timeout (1000�?0000). |
| `topProcesses` | `10` | Default top-N for `win_processes` (1�?00). |
| `includeSerialNumber` | `true` | Report BIOS serial in `win_system`. |
| `pwshPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell executable (`powershell.exe`/`pwsh.exe`). |

User:  这台电脑还剩多少内存？电池呢�?Model: [win_memory] �?72.8% used, 2× Samsung 8 GB DDR5-4800
       [win_battery] �?100%, AC online, scheme 381b4222�?(平衡)
```

All tools return canonical JSON; nullable fields stay `null` (schema `oneOf: [type, null]`) for a stable shape:

```json
{ "supported": true, "platform": "win32",
  "name": "13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700HX",
  "cores": 16, "logical_processors": 24,
  "max_clock_mhz": 2100, "current_load_percent": 3 }

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · Highlights：- **Value/render split** �?execute returns plain bytes/ms/percents; render is a pure projection, replay-safe
- **Locale-independent parsing** �?`netsh wlan` fields stay English on localized Windows; `powercfg` GUID regex language-independent; CIM `/Date(ms)/` �?ISO-8601
- **Sentinel handling** �?battery runtime is junk on AC (`0x04444444`) �?`null`; `AdapterRAM` uint32 wraparound documented
- **Cancellation/timeouts** �?`exec.signal` kills the child; hard per-query timeout; no orphans, no hangs
- **Domain vs infra failures** �?missing battery/WiFi/non-Windows �?`supported: false` values; spawn/timeout/abort �?thrown (`isError`)

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · Quality：59 unit tests (real-machine fixtures) · real `powershell.exe` smoke · real-composition smoke through production `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (`scripts/di-smoke.mjs`) · strict TS, `tsc` + `tsdown` �?`lib/`.

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · Development：```sh
pnpm install && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is host-provided and not in devDependencies (its peer chain references an unpublished package); typecheck uses `src/types.d.ts` ambient declarations, tests mock the module, the real module runs in the smoke script/Loader.

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · Model Experience：The 12 fixed schemas join the generated tool catalog �?no dynamic prompt injection. Token effect: fixed (constant schemas; one result message per call). KV cache: prefix-stable (schemas never change at runtime).

@huanlin/dsh-plugin-device-info README · Known limitations：Sensors need a third-party daemon · Bluetooth/display/traffic stats deferred · process CPU is cumulative seconds, not live rate · only `win_time` on non-Windows.
